title: muellera obtusa
intro: Muellera obtusa, commonly known as Mulethi or Yashtimadhu, is a plant species belonging to the family Pedaliaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the tropical regions of Asia and Africa, with a rich history of traditional use in Ayurvedic medicine. Muellera obtusa is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Muellera obtusa include glycosides, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-stress, and anti-inflammatory effects.
